text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"So it was just a dream after all...
...To think the turf would wither away like that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
To trouble me so,
and disturb my slumber...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having suffered through a bad dream,
Mejiro Ramonu wasn't able to rest well...
